description: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 22, and is marked at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio", also has a linear scale, spans from 0.0 to 0.8, and is marked at intervals of 0.2. The blue dash-dotted line represents the sparsity ratio before the gate, starting at approximately 0.01 at layer 0 and remaining relatively steady around 0.005 from layer 5 to 22. The orange dotted line shows the sparsity ratio after the gate, beginning at around 0.7 at layer 0, decreasing sharply to about 0.1 by layer 5, and then gradually declining to nearly 0.0 by layer 15 before slightly increasing to around 0.05 by layer 20. The green dashed line indicates the sparsity ratio after the average gate, starting at approximately 0.55 at layer 0, dropping to about 0.1 by layer 5, and then stabilizing near 0.0 from layer 10 to 22.
